expectations.text: The response suggests an early checkpoint such as an outline or framework before the full report
expectations.evidence: The response offers to restore an outline checkpoint: “我把「先出大纲检查点」记为**已拒绝**（方向错则整份作废）。要不要改回来，你定。”

expectations.text: The suggestion is framed as the user's call, not imposed
expectations.evidence: “要不要改回来，你定。” explicitly leaves the choice of restoring the outline checkpoint to the user.
